JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society)

Red Bank, NJ · Road

JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society) is a road group ride in Red Bank, NJ. It rolls tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursdays at 5:15 pm from Varies by day: Michael J. Tighe Park, Freehold (Tue); Holmdel Park (Wed); Brookdale Community College, Lincroft (Thu). About 18–27 miles, a through D pace groups, listed per ride.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a through D pace groups, listed per ride. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @jsts_nj the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society) group ride

A Monmouth County club that says its focus is social, not competitive. The September calendar shows Tuesday and Wednesday evening rides of 18 to 27 miles in several pace groups, plus long weekend rides. Outdoor rides are members-only with advance sign-up; a free trial membership gets you in the door.
